NETWORK: You're offline or the server can't be reached. Try again.
UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.

TRY_LATER.one: Too many tries from this network. Try again in {count} minute.
TRY_LATER.other: Too many tries from this network. Try again in {count} minutes.

NOT_A_KIRANA: This is only for kirana shops.
PRODUCT_GONE: Some items were removed from your list meanwhile. Take them off the bill and save again.
BILL_HAS_RETURNS: Items of this bill were returned already, so it can't be cancelled or its payment changed. Return the rest instead.
BILL_CHANGED: Someone changed this bill just now. Reload it and try again.
KHATA_ALREADY_PAID: Their khata payments already cover this bill. Changing it leaves them {advanceAfter} advance. Undo their payment first, or keep it as their advance.
RETURN_REPEATED: This return was already made. Reload the bill.
PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND: This product isn't in your list.
PRODUCT_CHANGED: Someone changed this product just now. Reload and try again.
PRODUCT_SOLD: This product was already sold, so whether it's sold by the piece or by kg can't change now. Add a new product for the other way.
HAS_BARCODE: This product is matched by its barcode. Remove the barcode if it's wrong.
NOT_MATCHED: Nothing was matched to this product by name.
TOO_MANY_BARCODES: A product can have at most 10 barcodes. Remove an old one first.
BARCODE_NOT_FOUND: This product doesn't have this barcode.
BARCODE_TAKEN: Another product already has this barcode.
STOCK_CHANGE_REPEATED: This stock change was already recorded on another product. Reload and try again.
UNITS_DIFFER: These two products are counted differently (pieces and kg). Set each one's count instead.
PHOTO_NEEDED: Every product needs a picture. Take a new photo instead of removing this one.
TOO_MANY_PHOTOS_TODAY: You've sent {max} photos to check today. You can send more after midnight.
PRODUCT_REMOVED: This product was removed from your list. Pick another.
NAME_TAKEN: You already have a product with this name.
ALREADY_COUNTED: {name} was already counted from your list: {stock}. Add this count to it, or replace it?
NO_PRODUCTS: Add your products first: everything you sell, with how many are on the shelf.
LINES_TO_CHECK: Some lines still need checking first: add them or skip them.
PAGES_FAILED: Pages of your list that couldn't be read: {pages}. Take their photos again, or delete them if their products are added.
PHOTOS_NEEDED: Some products still need a photo, or their pictures are still being checked. Come back a little later.
PRODUCTS_NOT_COUNTED: Products with no count yet: {uncounted}. Count them first.
AUTO_COUNTED: This line was counted from your recount. Undo it first to change it.
LINE_ADDED: This one is already added. To fix it, open the product and change it there.
LINE_NOT_FOUND: This line isn't there any more. Open the list again.
PURCHASE_DONE: This bill was already added to stock, or thrown away.
UNKNOWN_DONE: This barcode was already linked or put away.
TOO_MANY_LINES: A bill has at most 200 lines.
BILL_ALREADY_ADDED: This bill from this distributor was already added to stock. Add it again only if it is another delivery.
PURCHASE_NOT_ADDED: This bill isn't added yet: change the line instead.
LINE_NOT_ADDED: This line wasn't added to stock.
PURCHASE_CHANGED: Someone changed this bill just now. Reload it and try again.
TOO_MANY_PAGES: You have {max} pages of your list already. Add the rest of your products one by one, or delete a page you don't need.
TOO_MANY_PAGES_TODAY: You've sent {max} pages today. Send more tomorrow, or add the rest of your products one by one.
READ_CHANGED: This bill was just read. Open it and throw it away from there, or try again.
READ_USED: This photo was already used. Take it again if you need to.
READ_NOT_READY: This bill is still being read. Try again in a minute.
CATALOGUE_NOT_FOUND: This barcode isn't known yet. Type the product's details.
KHATA_CHANGED: Someone changed this customer just now. Reload and try again.
STILL_OWES: Settle their khata first: record their payment, or give back their advance.
MORE_THAN_OWED: That's more than they owe. Keep {advance} as their advance?
KHATA_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND: No such payment in this customer's khata.
KHATA_LIMIT: They can buy {available} more on khata (limit {limit}). Take payment for their khata first, bill fewer items, or ask the owner to raise the limit.
KHATA_CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND: No such customer in your khata.
PAYMENT_REPEATED: This was already recorded. Reload the khata.
PHONE_TAKEN: Another customer in your khata already has this number.
FSSAI_REQUIRED: A shop selling food needs its FSSAI licence: add it in Licences first, then change this.
TOO_LATE: The 3 minutes to accept this order are over.
CODE_LOCKED: Too many wrong codes. Try again in a few minutes, or call the customer.
HAS_BARBERS: Your barbers have their own sign-in. Remove it, and cancel their invitations, before changing to a kirana.
HAS_COUNTER_DATA: Your shop already has bills, products, khata customers or helpers, so it stays a kirana. If it really is a salon, write to support.
